fixed.explanation: ArrowExtensionArray._str_extract requires all groups to be named and relies on the pyarrow kernel. I changed it to build labels (name, or 0-based position for unnamed groups). It now takes the element-wise Python regex fallback whenever any group is unnamed, or when flags or a compiled pattern are used. It extracts groups by index.

query.intent: The str.extract implementation for the generic ArrowDtype string array (ArrowExtensionArray._str_extract) only uses the pyarrow extract_regex kernel and requires all groups to be named. It should fall back to the element-by-element Python re path when any capture group is unnamed (or flags/compiled pattern), labelling unnamed groups by position and named groups by name, mixed.
query.symptom: Series.str.extract on ArrowDtype(pa.string()) raises errors with no or partially named groups, or returns an all-missing column for the unnamed group when flags are used, unlike other dtypes.
